flags.title: What it flags
items: Each finding compares what a **page says** (a character or thread's declared profile) against what your **scenes show** — read at chapter checkpoints.
It's the analysis agent's reading, not authored truth — a queue of places to check, never a verdict you have to obey.

rows.category: the kind chip — Says vs shows · Slow drift · Page is silent · Never shown · Fact flip · Impossible · Broken rule
rows.severity: the triage color — high · medium · low (what to weigh first)
rows.Subject: who/what it concerns — a character, a thread, or the whole story
rows.Where: the chapter the issue actually occurs in (drawn from its evidence)
rows.Analyzed through: how far the run read — the same for every finding, so not where the issue is
rows.page says / scenes show: the declared profile vs the prose — the heart of the flag

acting.title: Acting on it
items: **Open …'s page** — edit the profile that's out of sync (the fix the finding points at).
**Verify in scenes** — open the scenes it draws on and read the prose for yourself before changing anything.
**Inspect thread** — jump to the thread a finding is about.
The amber **Suggestion** is the assistant's read — fenced off from the facts on purpose. It's advice, your call.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
items: **Confirmation** findings are consistency *confirmed* — nothing to fix; they sink to the bottom of the roster.

scale.rangeTitle: Trim rows by finding count — drag the low thumb up to hide lightly-flagged characters and focus the most-flagged.

review.suggestion: Suggestion — the assistant’s read, your call
review.intentionalTitleOn: Ruled intentional — click to resume flagging
review.intentionalTitleOff: By design (a deception/twist)? Rule it intentional so re-runs stay quiet
review.chapterEvidenceTitle: Read at chapter level — pick the scene that matches

sidebar.title: Coherence
sidebar.runTitle: Check coherence — diff each character’s page against what the story shows
sidebar.empty: No findings — they appear after you run analysis.
